changelog: Bare Metal Restore is available to read-only users again, scoped to their own endpoints. 3.2.105 made the page administrator-only; it is now gated per endpoint instead of per role, so a read-only account sees only its own customers' endpoints in the picker and can export only their images.
Includes 3.2.106: the release package ships database/migrations and auto-update.sh applies them; customer scope resolution fails closed when the customer tables are missing.
Includes 3.2.105: user roles are scoped to customers (issue #21).
